name: ImmoWP
description: French "passerelle immobilière": syncs listings from an agency's real-estate software (company-stated 75+ compatible tools, e.g. Hektor, Apimo, Netty, Immofacile, Ubiflow, Whise, SweepBright) into the agency's existing WordPress site. Price, photos, DPE energy labels and "sold" status update several times a day, with failed-import monitoring and a free listings plugin. €500 HT one-time (install + first year), then €150 HT/yr. Company-stated 200+ agencies since 2017. TrustMRR founded date: Sep 2021.

mentions.evidence: MRR $0 / 0 subs (one-time + annual invoices), ~$4,629 L30, ~$48,736 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 5, 2026 ~04:21 Warsaw (02:21 UTC). Note that the all-time Stripe figure is small relative to "200+ agencies since 2017", so some billing likely predates or sits outside this Stripe account (my inference).
mentions.indieAngle: Same play for PL real-estate CRMs (Asari, Galactica Virgo, EstiCRM, IMO) → WordPress/Webflow, or for car-dealer DMS → dealer website. Charge setup + annual maintenance; each new supported feed is a new SEO landing page.

whyItPrints: Pure Conductor-lane legacy glue. Agencies already pay for vertical CRMs that export XML/FTP feeds, and WordPress agencies don't want to rebuild sites. Tiny ACV, but integration maintenance is the recurring fee and switching is near-zero churn.
